title: Ijaarsa Gufuu
intro: Lafa bal’aa keessa darbee, namni dhuunfaa humna guddaa qabu tokko, aangoo fi meeshaa guddaa argate, imala wal-duraa duubaan godhe. Lubbuun kun hawaasa adda addaa kan qunnamee fi qormaata adda ta’e kan isa mudate yoo ta’u, gochaa fi ogummaa isaaniitiin seenaa fi amantii irratti mallattoo waaraa kan dhiise yoo ta’u, kuni hundi madda humna isaanii isa dhugaa ta’eef beekamtii kennuudhaan.
clues: Waan hundumaa irratti aangoo fi meeshaan naaf kennamee, karaa tokko hordofe.
Imalli koo gara bakka aduun itti lixxutti na geesse, achitti ummata tokko argadhe.
Hawaasa dubbii hubachuu dadhabe, gaarreen lama gidduu jiraatu na qunname.
Faayidaa dhuunfaaf osoo hin taane humna diigumsaa irraa of eeguuf danqaa akkan ijaaru na gaafatan.
Dallaa guddaa kana ijaaruuf humni Rabbiin biraa akka dhufe, hanga yeroo waadaan seenameetti akka dhaabbatu labse.
Maqaan koo yeroo baayʼee ‘Isa Gaanfa Lama’ jedhamee kan hiikamu siʼa taʼu, lafa kanarra ykn tarii bara adda taʼe lama akkan gaʼe argisiisa.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
